title: Brickwork
author: NotVeryNeat
rules:
A puzzle with a combination of standard constraints. I LOVE Kropki dots!! Estimation for difficulty is 1-1.5 stars. Enjoy!

Rules:

Normal sudoku rules apply.

Cages: Digits in cages must not repeat, and must sum to the total given in the top-left corner.

Arrows: Digits along an arrow sum to the number in the attached circle.

Kropki Dots: Digits separated by a white dot are consecutive. Digits separated by a black dot are in a 1:2 ratio. Not all dots are necessarily given.
